items.summary: A malicious or compromised HTTP/2 server withholding SETTINGS ACK can send RST_STREAM on a completed stream, planting a null pointer, and then send a PUSH_PROMISE for that stream, causing a null pointer dereference in the QNetworkAccessManager class of the Qt Network module that crashes the application.

Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password vulnerability in HAVELSAN Inc. Liman MYS allows Password Recovery Exploitation.

This issue affects Liman MYS: from 2.3.4-1124 before 2.3.5-1131.

A flaw has been found in HaschekSolutions PictShare up to 3.7.1. The impacted element is the function architect of the file src/inc/core.php of the component File Upload. This manipulation causes race condition. The attack can be initiated remotely. The attack's complexity is rated as high. The exploitability is regarded as difficult. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 3.7.2 is sufficient to resolve this issue. Patch name: 6306e33da630c04ddff60703922c2ec7b7539452. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

A vulnerability was detected in libimobiledevice up to 1.4.0. The affected element is the function webinspector_receive_with_timeout of the file src/webinspector.c of the component Web Inspector. The manipulation results in heap-based buffer overflow. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A security vulnerability has been detected in libimobiledevice up to 1.4.0. Impacted is the function afc_file_open of the file src/afc.c of the component AFC File Handler. The manipulation of the argument bytes leads to out-of-bounds read. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A weakness has been identified in libimobiledevice up to 1.4.0. This issue affects the function service_receive of the file src/afc.c of the component AFC Service. Executing a manipulation can lead to double free. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
